# Business Management System - Development Setup

## Project Overview
Full-stack business management application with multi-branch support for sales, purchases, inventory, and financial tracking.

- **Frontend:** ReactJS
- **Backend:** Node.js/Express
- **Database:** PostgreSQL/MySQL
- **Architecture:** Modular, scalable, and extensible

## Development Checklist

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
- [x] Scaffold Backend (Node.js/Express)
- [x] Scaffold Frontend (ReactJS)
- [x] Setup Database Configuration
- [x] Install Dependencies
- [x] Configure Project Structure
- [x] Create Build Tasks
- [x] Setup Initial Database Schema
- [x] Launch Development Servers
- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete

## Tech Stack
- Node.js (Backend)
- ReactJS (Frontend)
- Express.js (API Framework)
- MySQL (Database)
- JWT (Authentication)
- Docker (Deployment)
